window: Launch edition: reviews published 21 October - 8 November 2026
preheader: 24 children's and YA books reviewed in the British press, sorted by age, one line each.

books.author: John Devolle
books.subject: Preschool fiction (0-5)
books.line: A rhyming, brightly coloured picture book celebrating every kind of dog, for the very youngest dog fans.

books.author: Ged Adamson
books.subject: Preschool fiction (0-5)
books.line: On a walk with Mouse, Squirrel keeps wanting more things, until he sees what really matters is his friend.

books.author: Kim Gregory
books.subject: Preschool fiction (0-5)
books.line: A girl and her giraffe friend turn a painting rivalry into a joyful creative collaboration.

books.author: Diana Marciano, illustrated by David Pogran
books.subject: Preschool fiction (0-5)
books.line: An old fisherman turns down three mermaids' tempting bargains in a new fable translated from the Italian.

books.author: Graham Howie
books.subject: Preschool fiction (0-5)
books.line: A lonely mouse finally wins the attention of two squabbling ghosts who move into his creaky house.

books.author: Forest Xiao
books.subject: Preschool fiction (0-5)
books.line: One line and one simple drawing per page celebrate what fathers and babies teach each other.

books.book: Pomona: Stories of the Cat Witch
books.author: Tor Freeman
books.subject: 5-8 fiction
books.line: Six short, whimsical stories about a kind cat witch and her friends in the forest.
books.why: A gentle, episodic world with a warm central character and a ready-made cast of forest friends.

books.author: Sita Brahmachari, illustrated by Jane Ray
books.subject: 5-8 fiction
books.line: As a new baby is due, Nana stitches the family's stories of migration and belonging into a quilt.

books.author: Gaia Alessi
books.subject: 5-8 fiction
books.line: The Minotaur myth retold as a picture book about a gentle bull-headed boy searching for his place.

books.author: Shona Shirley Macdonald
books.subject: 5-8 fiction
books.line: Grub, a musician cat, enters a jam-making contest and his jams come to life and start to dance.

books.book: Beacons of Light: A Journey Through the World of Lighthouses
books.author: Gemma Koomen
books.subject: 5-8 non-fiction
books.line: A picture-book tour of lighthouses around the world, their history, their keepers and their oddities.

books.author: Shaun Tan
books.subject: Middle grade fiction (8-12)
books.line: A graphic-novel fable about a girl told by a stranger that she does not belong in the only world she knows.
books.why: A visual fable about belonging, nearly a decade in the making, from the creator of The Arrival.

books.author: Lottie Saahko
books.subject: Middle grade fiction (8-12)
books.line: An autistic girl sent to Lapland befriends a white wolf and sets out to lead him to safety.
books.why: A girl and a wolf on a perilous journey across Lapland, with Sami life and a changing climate behind it.

books.author: Mikey Please
books.subject: Middle grade fiction (8-12)
books.line: A human customer sets off chaos at a magical cafe in the woods; the first of a comic trilogy.
books.why: A comic fantasy world and cast first built in a prize-winning picture book, now growing into a trilogy.

books.author: Derek Keilty, illustrated by Louis Ghibault
books.subject: Middle grade fiction (8-12)
books.line: A girl finds out her grandad works for a secret ghost-rescue agency, then has to rescue him.
books.why: A secret ghost agency hidden under the town library, full of gadgets, and the start of a series.

books.book: Jekyll vs Hyde: The Potion of Doom
books.author: Jack Meggitt-Phillips, illustrated by Holly Swain
books.subject: Middle grade fiction (8-12)
books.line: A spoilt boy drinks a forbidden potion and unleashes a troublemaking alter ego in a comic gothic romp.
books.why: A comic spin on a famous classic, with a horrid hero and an alter ego who grows older each time he appears.

books.author: Sophie Anderson, illustrated by Elisa Paganelli
books.subject: Middle grade fiction (8-12)
books.line: Twelve stories, one for each month, mixing classic fairy-tale retellings with tales from world folklore.

books.author: Jasbinder Bilan
books.subject: Middle grade fiction (8-12)
books.line: In prehistoric England, a girl braves a mountain quest to save her baby sister, guided by a tiger's spirit.

books.author: David Owen
books.subject: Middle grade fiction (8-12)
books.line: To save his dad, a boy must win a Halloween wrestling tournament against the monsters of a graveyard.

books.author: Chloe Dalton
books.subject: Middle grade non-fiction (8-12)
books.line: The young readers' edition of the bestselling memoir about rescuing and raising a wild leveret.

books.author: Soman Chainani
books.subject: YA fiction (12+)
books.line: A 17-year-old's viral video makes him US president, then he is framed for murder at a summit of teen leaders.
books.why: A teenage president, a summit of teenage world leaders and a murder: a big, high-concept political thriller.

books.author: Elizabeth Acevedo
books.subject: YA fiction (12+)
books.line: A girl on probation risks her freedom to help her brother at college, who has started hearing voices.

books.author: Emma Hinds
books.subject: YA fiction (12+)
books.line: A 157-year-old revenant and his shapeshifting rival hunt missing books in a secret magical library.

books.author: Moira Buffini
books.subject: YA fiction (12+)
books.line: The final book of the Torch Trilogy, as telepaths and rebels march on the Capital.
